strategy.summary: Reproduce gh-25877 by building numpy at the buggy commit 567b57d751fb, applying the developer's test diff, and running only test_matrix_rank_rtol_argument. Expected transition: two of the three parametrizations (array rtol) fail on the buggy revision, and all three pass on the fixed revision. The test is shape-only, so it checks the broadcasting defect structurally rather than numerically. The maintainer's remark that the test would not have failed before the fix is a real risk to this transition and is listed below.

strategy.reproducing_test: test_matrix_rank_rtol_argument in numpy/linalg/tests/test_regression.py, parametrized over rtol in [0.0, [0.0]*4, np.zeros((4,))], asserting matrix_rank(np.zeros((4,3,2)), rtol=rtol).shape == (4,)
strategy.success_criterion: On buggy 567b57d751fb with the test diff applied: the scalar 0.0 case passes, while the [0.0]*4 and np.zeros((4,)) cases fail, because the unbroadcast rtol makes tol shape (4,4) and the comparison S > tol raises a broadcasting ValueError. On the fixed revision: all three parametrizations pass with result shape (4,). The transition is FAIL on buggy and PASS on fixed for the array-valued cases.

oracle.reference_source: the developer's test assertion res.shape == (4,) in the test diff
oracle.why: The assertion checks an integer array shape, so no floating-point tolerance applies. The check is exact, but it only detects the broadcasting failure and not wrong per-matrix threshold values.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: Two of three parametrizations (list [0.0]*4 and np.zeros((4,))) are expected to raise a broadcasting ValueError inside matrix_rank, because the unreshaped rtol produces a tol of shape (4,4) against S of shape (4,2). This is a failure, but it depends on the buggy code matching the pre-fix description. If the maintainer's remark is correct, these cases pass on buggy and the test does not reproduce the bug.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: All three parametrizations return an array of shape (4,) because rtol is reshaped with newaxis and broadcast to the batch shape, so the comparison S > tol has shape (4,2) and count_nonzero reduces it to (4,).
